blind.B1: Yes. Series has a real exercise arm: 60 min acute treadmill (16 m/min, 5% incline) vs mock-treadmill sedentary, in gastrocnemius of HSA-Cre;Hif1a fl/fl (KO) and fl/fl (WT) mice at ZT3 and ZT15 (S4.2.p1, S4.3.p1, S1.6.p1). Exercise factor carried by characteristics_ch1.4.treatment (ex/sed): 32 ex vs 32 sed of 64 libraries. The paper's exercise question is genotype and time-of-day modification of the postexercise transcriptome, not ex vs sed itself.
blind.B2: Paper comparisons (S1.6.p1-p2, Fig 5): KO vs fl/fl in exercised mice at ZT3 (516 DEGs) and ZT15 (91); KO vs fl/fl in sedentary mice at ZT3/ZT15 (figure only); ZT15 vs ZT3 within fl/fl sedentary (451), fl/fl exercise (273), KO sedentary (101), KO exercise (191); KO vs fl/fl overall 724 up + 749 down (contrast unstated). Cells are 2 genotype x 2 ZT x 2 treatment, 8 per cell (64 = 4F/4M each); one KO/exercise/ZT3 sample excluded for low coverage (S4.14.p1), so that cell has 7.
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one gastrocnemius per animal, each library a separate mouse (S4.15.p1 'individual data points represent individual animals'). Candidate pairing keys in packet A link at most 2 of 64 samples and are not a real unit. Cage is the only grouping (2-7 per cage, S4.2.p1) and is not in GEO.
blind.B4: One joint DESeq2 model on all samples: 'negative binomial generalized linear modeling and a design of ~0 + group + sex' (S4.14.p1), group = genotype x ZT x exercise cell. Contrasts are simple effects between cells.
blind.B5: 'All P-values were corrected for multiple comparisons using false discovery rate (FDR) and the alpha value was set to 0.1' (S4.14.p1). No fold-change cutoff stated. Independent filtering on mean of normalized counts, 20,224 genes passing. Counts: 516, 91, 451, 273, 101, 191, 724 up/749 down overall (S1.6.p1-p2).

checks.evidence: Exercise arm present (treatment ex/sed 32/32); run decision matches B1. In-vivo design, not an in-vitro mediator series.

Cells KO/WT x ZT3/ZT15 x EX/SED have n = 8 except KO ZT3 EX = 7. The one exclusion (GSM8647977, library 0156_44, 382 reads) is named with a reason and matches the paper's one low-coverage KO exercise ZT3 exclusion (S4.14.p1). Each contrast compares the exercise or sedentary cell to its own matched-state control.

design.contrasts: KO vs WT (control WT) and ZT15 vs ZT3 (control ZT3), the paper's direction (KO compared to fl/fl; ZT3 vs ZT15 pairs). GSEA OXPHOS NES +3.1 for KO vs WT ZT3 EX agrees with S1.6.p2 positive enrichment in KO. Caveat on Hif1a gene-level counts not dropping is explained (exon 2 deletion) and is recorded.
paper_reconstruction repeated_measure_unit 'none'; independent animals (B3). Packet A candidate keys link 2/64 samples.

~ sex + cell(geno x zt x trt) on 63 samples in one pydeseq2 model equals the paper's ~0 + group + sex (S4.14.p1). The additive ~ sex + zt + trt + geno secondary model for the overall KO vs fl/fl count is a declared deviation.
Sex crossed with all factors (KO 16F/15M, WT 16F/16M) and in the model. No batch or cage variable in GEO; the record says none added. Paper housed 2-7 per cage; cage/litter cannot be checked.

Integer raw featureCounts counts (integer_fraction 1.0, max 6.6e6), DESeq2 route correct. The p-value piling flags (frac p>0.9 = 0.33 and 0.30 for ZT15 EX KO-vs-WT and KO ZT15-vs-ZT3 SED) are in the contrasts with the fewest DEGs; counts are within 0-7% of the paper (101 = 101, 191 = 191, 89 vs 91, 479 vs 516), so normalization is not wrong. Low-count genes under pydeseq2 Wald give discrete p near 1. Benign for this case.
applied_threshold padj < 0.1, no fold-change cutoff, strict inequality, source 'paper' (S4.14.p1). padj < 0.05 only as audit. Paper numbers are fit by padj < 0.1 (packet B table).

Pairs compare the same contrasts at the same rule. The overall KO vs fl/fl pair (1305 vs 1473) is labelled a declared deviation because the paper does not state the contrast. Sedentary KO vs WT counts are reported as figure-only. The remaining gaps (479 vs 516, 438 vs 451, 263 vs 273) come from pydeseq2 vs R DESeq2 and are documented.
The case completed; no stop or refusal.

summary: 该案例分析了真实的运动组（ex vs sed），分组、n、排除样本与论文一致，使用与论文相同的 ~0+group+sex 联合 DESeq2 模型和 FDR<0.1（无 FC 阈值），差异基因数与论文接近（有两个对比完全一致）。两个 p 值堆积在 1 附近的标记出现在 DEG 最少的对比中，且计数与论文吻合，判断为低表达基因的离散 p 值所致，无需修改。
